reqfleet.about: Reqfleet is a cloud-native platform for distributed load testing that automates infrastructure management for JMeter and Locust scripts. It supports execution on both public cloud and private infrastructure (Bring Your Own Compute).
features: Distributed load testing infrastructure for JMeter and Locust
Private region (VPC/on-premises) execution support without inbound exposure
Per-minute billing based on Virtual User Minutes (VUM) or Compute Minutes (CM)
Bring Your Own Compute (BYOC) with 50% discount on usage
Role-based access control (RBAC) and organization/team management
Integration with GitHub Actions and CLI support for automation
Support for SSO via OIDC and SAML
reqfleet.pricing: Reqfleet offers a free tier with monthly credit allowances, alongside tiered subscriptions (Pro, Team, Enterprise). Pricing is based on Virtual User Minutes (VUM) or Compute Minutes (CM). Additional metered credits are available for purchase.
reqfleet.authorOrCompany: Reqfleet is owned, built, and operated by Lantern24.

scale-test.about: Scale Test is a paid Salesforce add-on designed to assist organizations in preparing for peak traffic and business growth by simulating production-like load within a full-copy sandbox environment. It enables developers and administrators to create, schedule, and execute performance tests to identify scalability issues, performance bottlenecks, and infrastructure limits before they impact production environments.
features: Full-copy sandbox performance testing at production load volumes
Real-time performance monitoring and live test dashboards (e.g., DMLs, platform events, RPS graphs, Apex hotspots)
Test Health Report for real-time reporting on load, limits, and saturation
Identification of performance hotspots like Most Used/Slowest Pages, Lightning Components, and REST APIs
Test scheduling and planning tools to manage test slots
Integration with Scale Center for root cause diagnostics and org performance metrics
scale-test.pricing: Scale Test is a paid add-on with pricing customized based on individual business requirements; Salesforce sales representatives coordinate package tailoring.

latestRelease.notes: The September 2025 update introduced the Test Health Report, which provides real-time reporting on load, system limits, and saturation, including throughput (Achieved vs. Planned RPS) and early warnings for system approaching capacity.

siege.about: Siege is an open-source HTTP load testing and benchmarking utility designed to allow web developers to measure the performance of their code under load. It supports HTTP/HTTPS regression testing, internet simulation, and brute-force modes, and can simulate a configurable number of concurrent users to stress-test a web server.
features: Supports HTTP/1.0 and 1.1 protocols
Supports GET and POST directives
Supports basic authentication, cookies, and transaction logging
Supports HTML parsing to harvest resources like style sheets, images, and JavaScript
Allows testing via configuration files (for regression and internet simulation) or command-line (for brute-force)
Records test duration, transactions, data transferred, response time, transaction rate, concurrency, and success status (200 OK)
Supports proxy server testing
siege.pricing: Open source; no pricing information found.
siege.authorOrCompany: Joe Dog Software (designed and implemented by Jeffrey Fulmer)

silk-performer.about: Silk Performer is an enterprise-class performance, load, and stress testing solution designed to assess the performance of Internet servers, database servers, distributed applications, and middleware by simulating hundreds or thousands of concurrent users.
features: Realistic load testing with virtual users
Comprehensive diagnostics and root cause analysis tools
Cloud-based testing with CloudBurst capability
Multi-protocol support including web, mobile web, and mobile native applications
Visual Studio extension for performance test development in C#
Integration with CI/CD tools like Jenkins
Reuse of functional tests from Silk Test or Selenium
silk-performer.pricing: Silk Performer offers an evaluation version with full functionality for 45 days (limited to 10 virtual users). Licensing for full production load tests is based on virtual users, with both on-premise and online licensing models available. Starting and modeling scripts in the Workbench does not require a license.

latestRelease.notes: Silk Performer 21.0 introduced support for AutoPass licensing, Java 11, and significant integration enhancements including new project upload wizards and command-line tools.

features: Distributed load testing
Automated test reporting
Acceptance criteria for automatic test evaluation
Continuous Integration (CI) support
Predefined test templates
Backup of reports and test logs for comparison
Customizable report templates
smartmeter.pricing: SmartMeter.io is available in a free version, as well as Pro and Enterprise versions. Licensing details are available via contact.

stormforger.about: StormForger is a performance testing as a service platform designed for HTTP APIs, providing an expressive JavaScript DSL to define test cases.
features: JavaScript DSL for test case definition
Support for HTTP verbs (GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, HEAD)
Dynamic content extraction via JSONPath, XPath, and regular expressions
Integration of various data sources and generators (random numbers, strings, file fixtures)

stresstimulus.about: StresStimulus is a load testing, stress testing, and performance testing tool for websites, mobile apps, and enterprise applications, developed by Stimulus Technology. It allows users to emulate hundreds or thousands of concurrent virtual users to monitor performance, pinpoint bottlenecks, and assess scalability.
features: End-to-end test wizard for recording, configuring, and executing tests
Autocorrelation and parameterization for dynamic web applications (e.g., Salesforce, SharePoint, Microsoft Dynamics 365)
Support for mobile, web, and enterprise platform load testing
Advanced recording proxy with HTTP/2 support
Real-time performance dashboards and interactive reports
Scripting options using the Fiddler .NET-based platform
Distributed load testing (on-premise or cloud)
Reuse of Playwright logic for performance testing
stresstimulus.pricing: StresStimulus offers various licensing models (per-machine and multi-machine) and durations (weekly, monthly, quarterly, annual, and permanent). Specific pricing is not publicly listed and requires requesting a quote based on requirements such as edition (Free, Pro, Enterprise, Service Provider), number of virtual users, support level, and specific modules.

taurus.about: Taurus is an open-source, automation-friendly framework for continuous performance and functional testing that extends and abstracts the functionality of leading testing tools. It serves as a convenience wrapper that hides the complexity of test configuration and execution.
features: Unified YAML/JSON-based test configuration
Support for multiple executors, including JMeter, Gatling, Locust.io, Selenium, Playwright, K6, JUnit, NUnit, PyTest, and others
Command-line tool (bzt) for test execution
Automated performance and functional testing
Integration with BlazeMeter for interactive reporting and cloud-based execution
In-console real-time test statistics

Pass/fail criteria management

Proxy2JMX conversion

tcpkali.about: tcpkali is a high-performance, open-source command-line tool designed for load testing and benchmarking TCP and WebSocket servers. It functions as both a traffic generator (client mode) and a data sink (server mode), capable of handling massive numbers of concurrent connections with minimal resource consumption.
features: Supports raw TCP and WebSocket (RFC6455) protocols.
Generates massive concurrent connections from a single host using interface aliases.
Efficient multi-core utilization via the --workers option.
Allows granular control over upstream and downstream bandwidth.
Supports custom message generation for traffic patterns.
Measures response latency percentiles using HdrHistogram.
Integrates with StatsD and DataDog for statistics reporting.
tcpkali.pricing: Free; licensed under the BSD 2-Clause License.

latestRelease.notes: The latest version listed in package repositories is 1.1.1, associated with the 2018-01-04 release.

the-grinder.about: The Grinder is a Java-based open-source load testing framework designed to facilitate distributed testing across multiple load injector machines. It is used for load, capacity, functional, and stress testing.
features: Distributed load testing framework with console-based monitoring and control of multiple injector machines
Dynamic test scripting using Jython and Clojure languages
Support for testing any Java-accessible system, including HTTP/HTTPS (web services), JDBC databases, RMI, IIOP, SOAP, and custom protocols
HTTP plug-in with support for cookie management, SSL, and connection throttling
TCP proxy utility for protocol interception and script recording
Graphical user interface (Java Swing) for console management and process monitoring
Centralized script editing and distribution capabilities
the-grinder.authorOrCompany: The Grinder project; originally developed by Paco Gómez and Peter Zadrozny, later maintained by Philip Aston. The repository at https://github.com/cossme/grinder is a fork initiated by Cyril and Olivier in 2018.

tsung.about: Tsung is an open-source, multi-protocol distributed load testing and benchmarking framework designed to simulate huge numbers of concurrent users for stress testing IP-based client/server applications. Originally developed in Erlang, it is highly scalable and supports a wide range of protocols, including HTTP, WebDAV, SOAP, PostgreSQL, MySQL, LDAP, MQTT, AMQP, and XMPP/Jabber.
features: High-performance distributed architecture allowing load generation across a cluster of machines
Support for multiple protocols: HTTP, WebDAV, SOAP, PostgreSQL, MySQL, LDAP, MQTT, AMQP, and XMPP/Jabber
XML-based configuration system for defining complex user scenarios
OS-level monitoring (CPU, memory, network) via SNMP, Munin, or Erlang agents
TCP, UDP, WebSocket, and TLS/SSL support with IPv4 and IPv6 compatibility
tsung.pricing: Tsung is open-source software released under the GPLv2 license and is free to use with no licensing fees or subscription costs.
tsung.authorOrCompany: Tsung development was started by Nicolas Niclausse. ProcessOne is associated with the project, and various companies and individuals have historically provided professional support and services.
aiFeatures: Built-in web dashboard for real-time monitoring of statistics like response times and server CPU usage
Randomization of user think-times and arrival rates using probability distributions for realistic traffic simulation
Dynamic scenario support that allows retrieving data from server responses at runtime to re-inject into subsequent requests

latestRelease.notes: The 1.8.0 release includes various fixes and enhancements to the framework.

vegeta.about: Vegeta is a versatile HTTP load testing tool and library designed for drilling HTTP services with a constant request rate. It is usable as both a command-line interface (CLI) tool and a Go library.
features: Usable as a command-line tool and a Go library
CLI designed with UNIX composability in mind
Avoids Coordinated Omission
Extensive reporting functionality
Supports distributed load testing
Easy to install via static binaries and package managers
Supports Prometheus metrics export
Configurable request rates, timeouts, workers, and DNS resolvers
vegeta.pricing: Vegeta is free and open-source, licensed under the MIT License. It includes a donate option via Bitcoin.

wapt-pro.about: WAPT Pro is a scalable performance and load testing solution designed for web applications, mobile apps, corporate systems (ERP/CRM), web APIs, and IoT platforms. It allows for testing with up to 1 million concurrent virtual users through distributed load generation.
features: Distributed testing with multiple load agents
Server and database performance monitoring (SNMP, WMI, ODBC, Apache)
Scripting support and embedded JavaScript for in-session calculations
Customizable pass/fail criteria and test results analysis
Integration with DevOps/CI environments, including Jenkins plugin and command-line interface
Full recording and playback of HTTPS/SSL pages
Support for IP spoofing and user connection speed emulation
Parameterization of requests using CSV files and dynamic values

webload.about: WebLOAD is an enterprise-grade, commercial load testing software designed for testing web and mobile application performance, scalability, and integrity. It allows users to simulate real-world traffic with virtual clients to identify performance bottlenecks and optimize systems under load.
features: JavaScript-based test scripting with IDE support for correlation, parameterization, and debugging
Goal-oriented testing (automated load scaling based on performance thresholds)
Real-time analytics dashboard with over 75-80 metrics and configurable report templates
Support for multiple protocols including HTTP/S, WebSockets, and REST APIs
Integration with APM tools (e.g., Dynatrace, AppDynamics, New Relic) and CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins)
Hybrid deployment options: cloud, on-premises, or fully-managed SaaS
Advanced correlation engine for managing dynamic session-specific data
webload.pricing: WebLOAD offers flexible, quote-based enterprise plans (SaaS or on-premise) and a pay-as-you-go model starting at $0.15 per Virtual User Hour (VUH). Subscription pricing is based on factors such as concurrent virtual users, deployment method, and term.

Configurable number of threads and connections
Customizable test duration
Support for adding custom HTTP headers
Detailed latency statistics reporting
Configurable socket/request timeout
wrk.pricing: wrk is open-source software, licensed under the Apache License 2.0 (as indicated by the LICENSE file in the repository), and is available for free.

Supports HTTP/1.1 with keep-alive connections

yandex-tank.about: Yandex.Tank is an extensible open source load testing tool designed for advanced Linux users, primarily used for performance benchmarking as part of automated load testing suites.
features: Support for multiple load generators (Phantom, JMeter, BFG, Pandora)
Performance analytics backend integration (Yandex.Overload)
Support for various ammo formats (e.g., plain URL list, access.log)
Test autostop functionality based on performance conditions
Customizable and extendable monitoring over SSH
Extensible plugin architecture for artifacts, monitoring, and result processing
